config_version.description: Shown on the smoke-test page to confirm the kiosk reads the console

ai_mode_extraction.description: Symptom extraction (Model B): prefer_on_device | only_on_device | prefer_in_cloud | only_in_cloud

ai_mode_question.description: Follow-up question (Model C). Kinyarwanda sessions always use the cloud

ai_mode_guidance.description: Patient message (Model E). Kinyarwanda sessions always use the cloud

ai_mode_routing.description: Department suggestion when the issue is unclear

ai_on_device_timeout_ms.description: How long Gemini Nano gets before the cloud answers (1000-120000)

ai_slow_device_cooldown_ms.description: After a timeout, skip Nano for this long (0-3600000)

kiosk_show_ai_details.description: Show On-device / Cloud indicators on the kiosk. true for demos and judging; false in a real hospital (in-app default: false)
